design_policy: Evidence-gated deterministic baseline precedes stochastic optimization. No probability or alpha claim absent walk-forward validation.

families.name: Black-Litterman Bayesian views
families.where: view updates and conviction-driven weight tilts
families.take: views have uncertainty and confidence, neutral starting portfolio
families.guard: do not invent posterior returns without calibrated forecast and covariance inputs

families.name: Grinold-Kahn active management / information coefficient
families.where: score performance and independently repeated decisions
families.take: evaluate realized correlation of forecast scores and future returns, transfer coefficient, active breadth
families.guard: do not claim genuine alpha from narrative confidence

families.name: Risk budgets, mean-variance, robust/CVaR
families.where: risk-aware weights, segment and covariance overlaps, downside stress
families.take: limit marginal exposure, normalize sector/benchmark risk and correlation
families.guard: large-cap AI factor correlation can create false diversification

families.name: Point-in-time walk-forward and backtest overfitting
families.take: available_at and ingested_at timestamps; immutable holdings and forecasts; forward-chaining test splits

families.name: Cost-aware turnover and buffer bands
families.take: explicit spread/slippage, turnover thresholds and market capacity; cash if insufficient capacity
families.guard: small-cap liquidity and rebalancing costs can erase signal

families.name: Software vertical SaaS cohort economics
families.take: NRR >110 and GRR >93 as empirical premium vertical software reference; track ARR, FCF, ROIC and installed base
families.guard: never award software P/E to employee-hour services based solely on product announcements

families.name: Discounted cash flow and reverse valuation
families.where: required execution growth to justify current price
families.take: reverse solve EPS or FCF growth embedded by current price; compare scenarios
families.guard: don't fake precision from terminal PE assumptions

implementation.baseline_algorithm: point-in-time gate, normalized component scores, proportional allocation, 15% ticker and 35% segment caps, remaining cash
implementation.tests: 8 deterministic local unittest cases passed 2026-11-03; GitHub Actions exact-head pending

No cost-aware optimizer or walk-forward backtest
